name: cue-evaluation-provenance-for-cue-values
instr:
CUE cannot currently explain which source expressions produced an evaluated value, especially incomplete or erroneous results. Add stable provenance without changing existing values, errors, syntax, ordering, compilation, or build behavior.

Each compiled ADT node with direct syntax records its source span. Synthetic nodes return valid empty provenance, while wrappers preserve wrapped provenance. Keep contributors in evaluator order, deduplicate repeated identities, and distinguish equal-looking source positions.

References retain their sites and targets. Unification combines every contributing scalar, vertex, and compound expression. Defaults identify selected contributors; IncludeDerived controls discarded alternatives. Failures retain the failing expression and available partial contributors.

Value.Provenance returns immutable public Origin records without exposing evaluator state. Lookups include the selected path and causal parent expressions. Runtime.CompileValue supports runtimes from internal/core/runtime.New and internal/core/runtime.NewWithSettings, with public values associated through internal/value.ToInternal. Public cue.Unify, evaluation, build, and context paths preserve existing results and match internal contributor identities and order regardless of query order. cuelang.org/go/internal/core/adt provides Node.Provenance, and cuelang.org/go/internal/core/compile provides CompileExpr.
